description: Guest is at the building the day after checkout, cannot get in (code already off the lock; next guest is in the unit). Must apologize, say the stay was yesterday, checkout was 10am, door code already off the lock, and a new guest is in. Do not send lockout/backup codes. Do not call live Hospitable.
guestMessage: The door code is not working, we can't get in. Can you please confirm what our apt # is?

context.suggestedResponseSnippet: Good afternoon, Alex, I'm sorry — your stay was yesterday. Checkout was at 10am. The door code is already off the lock, and we have a new guest in the unit, which is why you can't get in. Hope you had a great time in Portland!

requiredPhrases: door code is already off the lock

notes: Reverse of Michael day-before access. Checkout 2026-08-24 (Monday), asOfDate 2026-08-25. Deterministic _applyPostStayAccessPolicy. Schlage codes drop at 11AM ET on checkout day.
